qa.q: How do I book a free session?
qa.also: book, booking, appointment, meeting, consultation, call, free session, walkthrough, get started, talk to someone
qa.a: Book a free session and we look at how your work really happens. You leave with a written plan and an hours estimate, yours to keep. There is no cost and no jargon.

qa.also: what do you do, services, what can you help with, what do you offer, automate, automation ideas, examples
qa.a: Two ways we help. Automations that clear the repetitive work: quotes and invoices, customer replies, bookings and reminders, moving data between apps, your numbers every week, and records you can show. And digital tools built around your business: websites that win trust, staff and customer portals, and live dashboards.

qa.also: how long, timeline, how quickly, how soon, weeks, turnaround, when will it be ready
qa.a: We start with one automation, usually built in one to two weeks depending on the job. You see it run on your real jobs, checked alongside the way you do it now, before it goes live.

qa.also: how it works, process, steps, what happens, get started, next steps, onboarding
qa.a: Three steps. We watch the work and leave you with a written plan and an hours estimate, yours to keep. We build one automation first, usually in one to two weeks, and you see it run on your real jobs. Then you own it: we hand over the logins, train your team, and fix or tweak anything free for the first 30 days.

qa.q: Do you build apps or portals?
qa.also: app, mobile app, phone app, portal, staff portal, customer portal, client login, iphone, android
qa.a: Yes: staff and customer portals. Job tracking, photos, invoices and approvals in your own app on every phone. Each person sees only what they need, with your logo and colours and a secure sign-in, and it installs on the home screen like a normal app.

qa.q: Can you build me a website?
qa.also: website, new website, web design, rebuild my site, redesign, seo, google, multilingual, landing page
qa.a: Yes. We build fast, multilingual websites that win trust and turn visitors into calls. They are easy for you to update with no developer needed, set up so Google understands what you offer, with enquiry forms that come straight to your inbox.

qa.also: price, pricing, cost, fees, charge, quote, expensive, cheap, budget, rates
qa.a: It depends on the task and the tools involved, so we don't publish a price list. The first session is free. After it you get a written plan, and the scope and price are agreed in writing before any work starts. Fixes and tweaks are free for the first 30 days after launch.

qa.also: location, address, office, auckland, wellington, christchurch, nationwide, new zealand, remote, outside auckland
qa.a: We're based in Auckland and work right across New Zealand. Most of the work happens remotely, and we travel for the first walkthrough when it helps.

qa.q: Do I own what you build?
qa.also: ownership, logins, accounts, lock in, contract, cancel, stop working with you
qa.a: Yes. Systems are set up in your own accounts, so you keep them if you stop working with us. We hand over the logins and train your team.

qa.also: privacy, data, security, privacy act, gdpr, stored, hosting, ai training, confidential
qa.a: Your data stays yours. We handle it under the Privacy Act 2020, keep what we store for you in New Zealand or Australia, and never use it to train anyone's AI model.

qa.q: What happens in the free session?
qa.also: free session, consultation, walkthrough, first meeting, discovery, what to expect, assessment, audit, first step
qa.a: We sit with whoever actually does the job and look at how the work really happens today. You leave with a written plan and an hours estimate, yours to keep even if you don't hire us. There is no cost and no jargon, and it can happen on site or remotely.

qa.q: Which software do you work with?
qa.also: software, tools, integrations, connect, microsoft 365, outlook, excel, teams, google workspace, gmail, sheets, xero, myob, pos, booking system, new software
qa.a: Most automations connect the tools you already pay for: Microsoft 365 (Outlook, Excel, Teams, OneDrive and SharePoint), Google Workspace (Gmail, Calendar, Sheets and Drive) and Xero. Where your booking, point-of-sale or job software can export to Excel or Google Sheets, or sends you emails, we work from that. Most of the time you won't need new software.

qa.q: What support do you offer after launch?
qa.also: support, maintenance, after launch, help later, monitoring, fixes, tweaks, monthly plan, pay as you go, aftercare, warranty
qa.a: We set up monitoring where the tools allow, so most problems are caught early. Fixes and tweaks are free for the first 30 days after launch. After that, support is a monthly plan or pay as you go, whichever suits you, with one named contact reachable in New Zealand hours.

qa.also: who will i deal with, contact person, account manager, team, developer, builder, ticket, reach you, response, new zealand hours
qa.a: You deal directly with the person who builds it: one named contact who knows your business, reachable in New Zealand hours. No ticket queue and no hand-offs.

qa.q: Which industries do you work with?
qa.also: industries, industry, sectors, cafe, takeaway, trades, builder, plumber, electrician, clinic, salon, shop, dairy, retail, adviser, accountant, transport, delivery, my type of business
qa.a: We work with small and growing New Zealand businesses, including cafés and takeaways, trades and building, clinics and salons, shops and dairies, advisers and accountants, and transport and delivery. If your business isn't on that list, we look at the repetitive work you do every week and start there.

qa.also: too small, small business, sole trader, one person, solo, how small, worth it, size
qa.a: If you spend more than about three hours a week on the same task, it's usually worth a look, whether you have one van or forty staff. Sole traders are very welcome.

qa.also: ai, artificial intelligence, automation meaning, what does automation mean, chatgpt, how does ai help, explain
qa.a: It means taking the jobs your team does the same way every week, like quotes, reminders, retyping and reports, and building systems that do them for you. You keep the final say: anything involving money, complaints or judgement can be sent to you to check first.

qa.also: training, train staff, teach, handover, show my team, language, hindi, punjabi, learn
qa.a: Yes. When an automation goes live we hand over the logins and train your team to use it, in plain words. Training can be in English, Hindi or Punjabi, whichever your team prefers.

qa.also: no shows, no-show, missed appointments, reminders, booking reminders, confirmations, rebooking, waitlist, cancellations, text reminders, sms
qa.a: Yes. We set up confirmation, reminder and rebooking texts that cut down no-shows without anyone chasing. They work with the booking system you already use, cancelled spots can be offered to people on a waitlist, and a follow-up text after the visit can ask for a review.

qa.q: Can you automate quotes and invoices?
qa.also: invoices, invoicing, quotes, quoting, billing, payment reminders, chasing payments, xero invoices, voice memo quote, accounts
qa.a: Yes. Site notes or a voice memo become a draft quote in your own prices and wording, and approved jobs become an invoice ready to check and send. Invoices land in your accounting app with nothing retyped, and polite payment reminders go out on time.
qa.link_label: How to automate quotes and invoices

qa.q: Can you do my taxes or accounts?
qa.also: tax, taxes, tax return, gst return, accountant, accounting, bookkeeping, ird, tax advice, do my books
qa.a: No, we don't do tax returns or give tax advice. That's a job for your accountant. What we can do is make the records behind it tidier: invoices going straight into Xero, receipts filed as the work happens, and fuel and mileage logs kept for you, so they're easier to hand over.

qa.also: dashboard, dashboards, reports, reporting, live numbers, sales figures, kpi, business numbers, charts
qa.a: Yes. A live dashboard shows sales, jobs and cash in one view that updates itself, wherever you are. It's built around the numbers you care about, alerts you when a number moves outside your normal range, and is easy to share with your team or accountant.

qa.q: Can you help with customer replies and Google reviews?
qa.also: google reviews, reviews, review replies, customer replies, enquiries, emails, messages, answer customers, faq, opening hours questions
qa.a: Yes. Opening hours, pricing and directions are answered quickly on your website and by email, and replies to Google reviews are drafted in your own tone for you to approve. Urgent messages are flagged to you straight away.
